quality_findings.finding: One 5,495-character Imami row came back summarised (Latin/Arabic letter ratio 0.72); the ratio floor was raised from 0.5 to 1.0.

No reviewer-measured meaning-error rate for hy-mt2 output exists in the repository as of 2026-11-21. The only measured rates are mechanical screen outcomes (pilot 1 of 60 rejected under screen-v2; batches 1 of 1,211 and 2 of 874) and say nothing about meaning.
quality_findings.source: searched datasets/hadith-data/DATA_QUALITY_REPORT.md, diagnostics/translation-run/README.md and summary.json, machine_translation_candidates/README.md, .omc/research on 2026-11-21

quality_findings.finding: 15 rows were never sent because one sentence exceeds 5,500 characters; 11 flagged master rows remain uncovered.

Gap-fill run 2 reading of 58 outputs stratified by tradition, work and length: 7 had a meaning-level error (12 percent); four of the seven read a common noun as a proper name (the imperative 'aslim' as the name Aslam, 'al-fatima' (the weaner) as Fatima, 'a'bud' (slaves) as ʿAbud, 'al-ʿaraq' (sweat) as the place Arq), others were 'adhdhana' (call to prayer) read as 'gave permission', 'khalatuhu' (maternal aunt) as paternal aunt, and 'al-khitan' read as two males. Short chainless texts and sources with ambiguous common nouns are the weak spot, as in the first pilot.

The terminology prompt (60-row paired pilot, 58 compared) put the honorific in one parenthetical form 137 times against 56, used the glossary's ʿ scheme 64 times against 0, and 'God' 1 time against 4, with no worse meaning in a 36-pair reading; it also produced 'O the Messenger of Allah' in 7 draft-1 outputs (fixed by vocative entries) and occasional macron transliteration (guarded; the row is retried with the base prompt), and renders a bare honorific with no subject ('And (peace and blessings be upon him) said') where the Arabic omits the Prophet's name.
At temperature 0.7 the same prompt gave different meanings on the same source in two runs (a dropped 'not' on pc_73910), so a single sample is partly noise.

Run 2 stopped at 7,046 of 31,090 selected reports because the OpenRouter account balance reached zero (HTTP 402 'Insufficient credits', limit_source openrouter_credits); the key's own limit had 47.97 USD remaining. About 24,000 reports remain; the estimated remaining cost is about 1.3 USD.
